description: Exact source outermost serration chain, including peaks and valleys; joins broad sloping fixed hull. Not a constant-width offset or Y-sampled approximation.

Starboard.note: First vertex at Y82.1 brackets the start of low rim; use chain interpolation to requested Y136 start. Final source vertex Y171.14 corresponds to original high-lip endpoint Y168.28; preserve deltaY for tooth matching instead of radial-only same-Y offsets.

Port.note: First vertex at Y82.1 brackets the start of low rim; use chain interpolation to requested Y136 start. Final source vertex Y171.14 corresponds to original high-lip endpoint Y168.28; preserve deltaY for tooth matching instead of radial-only same-Y offsets.

Ventral.description: Ventral source aperture is an unserrated five-corner chain with a microscopic bevel, not the dorsal 28-tooth strip. These are exact neighboring outer-bevel edges; do not mirror the dorsal 1–3-unit sweep onto this bank.

Starboard.note: Actual ventral aperture bevel edge only; no analogous wide serrated strip exists on this aperture chain.

Port.note: Actual ventral aperture bevel edge only; no analogous wide serrated strip exists on this aperture chain.
